text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The State Ownership Fund has cancelled a contract to sell a 51 percent stake in first-tier Azomures SA to the Bucharest-based Euro Trading company.
- The SNCFR railway authority has to cash 420 billion lei from bad debtors.
- Feist Incorn of Germany is interested to buy a 51 percent stake in the Darmanesti refinery.
- Only two of the 50 ships owned by Romania's state-run fishing fleet are operational, the paper says.
